sources_opened_with_numbers_read.what_read: Kurihara & Matsumoto, Asia-Pacific Financial Markets 2026. 'We used the Binance cryptocurrency exchange API to obtain 1-min closing prices and trade count data.' Four regimes: Bull Feb 25-Mar 25 2024, Bear Jun 22-Jul 19 2024, Sideways Aug 24-Sep 24 2024, Crash Jan 30-Mar 1 2025. Large-cap BTC/ETH, mid LTC, small BIFI/CITY/PIVX/GNO/QKC. Granger null 'using BTC returns from one minute prior does not improve the prediction accuracy of ALT returns' rejected at 5% for all pairs. Large/medium caps: 'extremely high correlation coefficients at lag0, with no significant reactions observed in subsequent or previous periods.' Small caps QKC/BIFI/CITY 'slightly higher correlation coefficients at lag-1 than at lag0'. Fee assumed 0.02%.

Guo, Sang, Tu, Wang, JEDC 163 (2024) abstract verbatim: lagged returns of other cryptocurrencies predict focal coins on Binance; long-short portfolio 'sizable return out-of-sample after accounting for transaction costs'; mechanism 'common shocks among cryptocurrencies coupled with the limited attention of investors lead to slow information diffusion across coins'. No numeric return on the opened page (the 2.16%/day figure appears only in a search snippet and is NOT cited).

Frontiers in Blockchain 2026 'Microstructure alpha'. Binance spot+perp, BTC ETH SOL AVAX LINK DOT, Aug 2025-Feb 2026, minute bars. OLS microstructure model +1.23% incremental R2 over random walk (DM t=1.28). 'All net Sharpe ratios are deeply negative: -31.29 to -52.05 on spot, -10.68 to -18.42 on futures.' Turnover 124-204x notional/day. Cross-asset transfer poor; block-diagonal by asset. NEGATIVE evidence for minute-scale flow signals.

Quarter-Hour Effect, Binance USDT perps BTC ETH XRP SOL DOGE ADA, Jan 2021-Oct 2024, 10s bars. Quarter-hour opening order imbalance predicts returns over 'four to twelve hours', peak 8-12h; but sign-weighted forecast target 'averages about 0.5 bp per boundary, about one tenth of a single standard-tier taker fee'. Needs order-flow data the screen does not have.
Short-horizon mean reversion, 183 Binance pairs, 15-min horizon: 'gross edge peaks near 1.3 bp per trade against a 5 bp round-trip cost' - fee-trapped, confirms CONSTRAINTS.
